summary.headline: Saturn, Reception, and Principality
summary.text: Astrological judgment of a man’s distress in his work and eventual principality, interpreting Saturn’s hatred and reception, the lords of the ascendant and seventh, and the Moon’s six-degree application. Timing is assigned first to six days, then Venus reaching the ascendant degree, and finally sixty days when Venus entered the horoscope degree in Libra-related significations.
